text:
Hannah C: Heads-up 5 candidate Priyanka Rao onsite Thurs 2026-10-14 09:30 PT for SWE loop. Ops asks: 1) prereg + lobby escort, 2) loaner laptop (Mac) imaged with Zoom & VPN by 08:00, 3) quiet room for a breastfeeding break at ~11:15, 4) childcare stipend info to share, 5) vegetarian + sesame-free lunch. Also one panelist (Marco) will join remotely from LA and needs a wired room.

Ben R: I can meet them at the north lobby at 09:20 and escort up. Please add my name to prereg.

Hannah C: Thanks Ben  please use "Redwood reception" as check-in. Candidate will bring driver's license. Priyanka has a small stroller; front desk to allow staged storage.

IT Support: We have loaner-mba-09 available. Will image with candidate preset and install Zoom/VPN. DM candidate email so I can create an account and test remote call. Imaging ETA 07:30.

Hannah C: Email: priyanka.rao+candidate@example.com. FrontDeskBot, please prereg and flag "breastfeeding room" and "stroller access" on the visitor record.

FrontDeskBot: Prereg submitted. badge_ref=RV-6444. Flags: "breastfeeding room" and "stroller". PDF uploaded to #people-ops-uploads. Please include escort Ben R.

CateringTeam: Noted vegetarian + sesame-free. Ordering boxed lunch labeled "Priyanka  veg, sesame-free" and separate plate for panelists.

ChildcareFund: FYI we offer a one-time childcare stipend up to $75 for onsite interviews. Candidate can submit receipts to expenses@redwood.com with code CAND-CHILD-2026. We'll need claimant name and receipts within 30 days. I'll DM a short explainer to Hannah.

Ben R: I'll be at north lobby 09:20. Do we have a quiet room reserved?

Hannah C: Reserve Quiet Room A 11:00-11:45 for a private breastfeeding break; label it "private" and scent-free. Also reserve Conf C (wired) 09:25-12:30 for Marco remote panel with wired ethernet.

IT Support: Imaging done 07:10. Username priyanka.rao+candidate@example.com created. VPN and Zoom test OK. Loaner assigned: loaner-mba-09. I'll leave a power adapter and sticky with temp creds.

FrontDeskBot: Badge printed. Escort assigned: Ben R. Quiet Room A reserved and marked scent-free. Conf C wired and AV-checked.

RecruiterBot: Candidate notified with logistics, parking code "GUEST-FAM" and childcare stipend details. Priyanka replied: "Thank you, see you Thursday."

Hannah C: Perfect  closing loop. If anything changes, reply here.

Ben R: All set  see you Thursday. :thumbsup:
